'''Gilroh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He deserted after five years on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and escaped thanks to a traveling hero.

==Biography==
A [[Republic trooper]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Gilroh was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] from [[3647 BBY]] until [[3643 BBY]], when he decided to desert.<ref name="TOR" /> Stationed on Taris at Waypoint Station Draay, Gilroh was one of many troopers who had been serving on the planet for the last five years, despite it only being a one-year assignment. Five years of attacks by [[rakghoul]]s, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] had broken Gilroh and his friends' spirits, until they finally gave up.

Around the year [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR" /> Gilrooh was part of the monthly supply convoy sent from [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Cresh]] to [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]] in the west. He, [[Ferdoin]], [[Geozel]], and the rest of the convoy decided to desert on one of their runs, leaving Morne without supplies as they hid in the wilderness.

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Draay's [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] [[Kahrin Wek]] grew concerned over the lack of response from Morne, so she asked a traveling hero, who had helped her expose her superior [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gardit]]'s corruption, to investigate. The hero found the convoy, and Gilroh attempted to lie that they were only stopping to rest. But he quickly gave up and told the truth, asking the stranger what they planned to do.<ref name="TOR" />

To Gilroh's surprise, instead of turning them in, the hero gave Gilroh enough credits to buy a spot on a smuggler's ship. Gilroh thanked the hero and told them that he planned to find his girlfriend and try to fix things between them. The hero would inform Gilroh's superior Commander [[Yajak]] that they had found the convoy's bodies in the wilds, ensuring their safe escape.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gilroh was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears as part of the Taris mission "AWOL". The player can choose to allow the troopers to desert, as the light side option, or force them to return to service as the dark side option.
